handoffs.message: DEP-002 ready for review. Added a first-class deployment saga backbone under services/control-plane/governance/ (deployment_saga.py, deployment_saga.contract.md, test_deployment_saga.py, smoke_test_deployment_saga.py), wired pantheon.deploy to emit a deployment_saga bootstrap plus consistency_contract=DEP-002, and anchored the L1 policy docs to the implementation. Verified with python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/governance -p 'test_deployment_saga.py', python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/governance -p 'test_deployment_plan.py', python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/cron -p 'test_*.py', python3 services/control-plane/governance/smoke_test_deployment_saga.py, python3 services/control-plane/cron/smoke_test.py, and python3 -m py_compile services/control-plane/governance/deployment_saga.py services/control-plane/cron/service.py. Review notes: services/control-plane/governance/review_dep002_codex_zh.md. Known unrelated repo issue: governance-wide discover with -p 'test_*.py' still hits existing pytest-only CAP-001 tests.

All 3 acceptance criteria met: atomic bootstrap verified, idempotent consumer ordering aligns with EVENT_ORDERING_AND_DELIVERY_GUARANTEES.md, compensation write-owner boundaries preserved per DATABASE_OWNERSHIP_AND_SHARED_CLUSTER_POLICY.md. Rollback linkage correctly sourced from DeploymentPlan. Tests: 7/7 unit + 12/12 smoke. See review_dep002_claude_approved_zh.md.
